Date of Award: 12.05.2023

Brief facts of the case
The complainant was admitted to Lakeside Demo Nursing Home for three days in January 2023 for
treatment of a kidney stone. He lodged a claim for Rs. 1,20,000 under the policy. The policy
had been in force since March 2021. The complainant states that the condition was diagnosed
for the first time during this admission, after the policy began.

Insurer's submission
The insurer repudiated the claim under the pre-existing disease clause. It submitted that a
discharge summary mentioned abdominal pain "on and off for some time" and argued that the
condition therefore existed before the policy was taken.

Observations and conclusion
The discharge summary does not record any earlier diagnosis or treatment. A vague history of
pain is not proof that the disease was diagnosed before the inception of the policy. The
insurer has not produced any document showing prior consultation.

AWARD
Taking into account the facts and circumstances of the case, the complaint is allowed. The
insurer is directed to pay Rs. 1,20,000 to the complainant within 30 days.

Dated at Demo Office on 12.05.2023
INSURANCE OMBUDSMAN
